messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'dedicated-us-west2-g4' p99 latency breach (5m window). Queue depth spiked to 480, pool nodes at 100% for 6m. Autoscaler observed cold-warmup delay. Alert ID: INC-1799999000

Jana (oncall): seeing it, joining. what's the customer impact? any streaming stalls reported?

Sara (support): multiple customers reporting streaming stalls and partial responses for chat streams (two support tickets with attachments). One is an enterprise customer on dedicated plan, reports p99 errors and stalled chunking.

Kevin - runtime: adding context — the autoscaler attempted scale up at t+30s but warmup handshake took longer than expected. KV cache coldpath triggered; many requests hit slow path.

Maria - eng-sre: confirmed. Handshake traces show GPU init + model warming took ~65s for new node (expected ~15s). Something is delaying model mmap and coldfill.

Jana (oncall): steps: 1) gather p95/p99 numbers and affected routes. 2) check if manual pool add helps. 3) consider enabling burst_cap for this customer. Anyone on quick wins?

Kevin - runtime: quick check dashboards: p95 ~420ms (ok), p99 ~3.2s (bad). Streaming tail percentiles show stalls at the tail (clients waiting for final chunk). Graph: `/dashboards/dedicated/1799999000`

Maria - eng-sre: running query to list queued requests by route:
```
SELECT route, count(*) as queued, avg(wait_ms) FROM request_queue WHERE pool='dedicated-us-west2-g4' AND ts > now()-5m GROUP BY route ORDER BY queued DESC;
```
Results: chat.stream.v1: 310 queued (avg wait 34000ms), generate.text.v2: 120 queued (avg wait 18000ms)

Kevin - runtime: looks like chat.stream.v1 dominates. The routing policy pinned those requests to GPU type A; alternate compatible variants exist (quantized model on type B). Suggest immediate routing fallback policy to route overflow to 'dedicated-us-west2-b' quantized variant.

Jana (oncall): can we flip fallback now? risk?

Kevin - runtime: low risk, models are compatible but quality may degrade slightly. Will implement 10% rollout to start.

Sara (support): if we route to quantized variant, please note in support notes that customers may see minor output variance. I'll prep a message.

Maria - eng-sre: meanwhile I'm SSHing into the node that failed to finish warmup. Seeing repeated mmap EAGAIN from model server during preload. Suspect kernel-level paging pressure on the instance.

Jana (oncall): can we add nodes manually to increase headroom while root cause investigated?

Kevin - runtime: yes, manual scale requested. Doing: `infra scale pool dedicated-us-west2-g4 +3 --reason "live mitigation"`

IncidentBot: Scheduled job queued: scale job id 78910. Estimated available in ~35s (node bootstrap).

Maria - eng-sre: while nodes booting, bumping handshake timeout to 120s to avoid aborts that exacerbate queue thrash. Patch rolling to pool config now.

Kevin - runtime: enabling routing fallback to quantized variant at 10% now. Command: `routing set fallback chat.stream.v1 -> chat.stream.quant.v1 --rollout 10`

Jana (oncall): monitoring p99 and queue depth. Please post updates every 2 minutes.

Sara (support): support note drafted: "We're investigating intermittent streaming stalls for customers in US-WEST2. Temporary routing and capacity changes are being applied to mitigate impact. You may notice minor output differences while we stabilize." Will send if impact continues >30m.

Alex PM: flagged for customer comms — please keep me in loop, I may need to notify enterprise contacts if SLA thresholds crossed.

Maria - eng-sre: scale job completed, new nodes booted but one node shows slow disk io; evicting it from rotation to avoid repeat. Evict command: `infra evict node i-0abc123 --pool dedicated-us-west2-g4`. Pool healthy nodes: +2 available.

Kevin - runtime: routing fallback at 10% has reduced queue on primary pool by ~22% within 60s. p99 now 1.4s and trending down. Streaming stalls reports reduced.

Jana (oncall): good. still seeing some tail at ~900ms. keep an eye. Maria, root cause next?

Maria - eng-sre: investigating node type kernel config and VM swappiness; suspect a regression in init script introduced last deploy that defers mmap prefetch. Filing bug and rolling revert to init version v2.1.

Kevin - runtime: suggested medium-term mitigations: pre-warm model in reserve nodes, reduce handshake serializations, and add autoscaler health check to confirm mmap success before announcing node ready.

Jana (oncall): action items: 
- Maria: revert init script and run retrospective for warmup timing (owner)
- Kevin: implement fallback routing playbook and autoscaler healthcheck ticket (owner)
- Sara: keep customers updated, escalate to account teams if SLA > 15m
- Alex: prep comms if enterprise affected >30m

IncidentBot: Incident severity bumped to SEV-2 due to sustained p99 breach and multiple customers impacted. Pager rotation notified.

Jana (oncall): handing off to Kevin for overnight monitoring at 03:00 UTC. I'll create a short runbook in this thread with checklist.

Kevin - runtime: acked. I'll monitor for 3h and escalate to Maria if p99 > 2s persists. Posting runbook now: 
- Check /dashboards/dedicated/pool-health
- Confirm fallback routing status `routing status chat.stream.v1`
- If p99 > 2s: enable fallback to 50% and request manual scale +5
- If stalls worsen: evict suspicious nodes and divert traffic to alternate region (us-east)

Sara (support): I'll keep tickets updated and send note to account managers if we hit the 30m mark.

Alex PM: thanks team. Please flag any decision where we need customer-facing explanation.

Jana (oncall): closing on-call shift note: handoff complete to Kevin - runtime. CD: incident open, partial mitigation in place (routing fallback + manual scale), root cause suspected (init script causing mmap slowdown). Will update later with postmortem link. :thumbsup:

Support Bot: Ticket updates queued for affected customers (ids: T-4551, T-4553).

Kevin - runtime: logging final note before monitoring: fallback routing scaled to 25% due to continued tail; p99 at 1.1s. Will escalate if trends reverse.

IncidentBot: Incident ongoing. Next update due in 15 minutes.
